title: The Influenza Blueprint: How Viruses Invade
tagline: A molecular tour of the flu virus, from its structure to the moment it enters a cell.
description: Explore the structure of the influenza virus and the surface proteins that let it latch onto airway cells. A clear animated walkthrough of how a single particle begins an infection.

title: Lock and Key: How a Flu Virus Binds a Cell
tagline: The first contact between virus and host, shown at molecular scale.
description: Follow hemagglutinin as it recognizes receptors on the surface of a host cell. This episode shows why binding is the decisive first step and how it shapes which cells the virus can infect.

title: Inside the Cell: The Influenza Life Cycle
tagline: From entry to exit, how a virus turns a cell into a factory.
description: Watch the complete replication cycle: entry, release of genetic material, hijacking of cellular machinery, assembly, and the exit of new viral particles that spread the infection.

title: The Body Fights Back: Immune Mobilization
tagline: Inside the layered defenses that respond when a pathogen gets through.
description: A detailed look at how the immune system detects, contains and remembers an infection. Understand the roles of innate and adaptive immunity, and why fever and fatigue accompany the response.

title: Antibiotics, Antivirals and Vaccines
tagline: Three tools against infection, and why each one works on different targets.
description: Learn how antibiotics, antivirals and vaccines differ, what each one targets, and why using the right tool matters for recovery and for public health.

title: Training the Immune System: How Vaccines Work
tagline: A short introduction to prevention, and why preparation beats treatment.
description: A concise explanation of how vaccines teach the immune system to recognize a pathogen before it can cause serious illness, and how that protects individuals and communities.
